title: Christ of Saint John of the Cross by Salvador Dalí
episode: Season 5, Ep.2: Christ of Saint John of the Cross by Salvador Dalí
description: Dalí’s Christ on the cross seen from directly above, floating over a bay. Glasgow bought it in 1952 for a price many thought outrageous. It has since been slashed by a visitor, restored, and voted Scotland’s favorite painting.
